paginas.texto: Diego had a new microphone and one very big problem: he had no story for Friday.
'Have you ever seen the aurora?' he asked the cook. 'Twice,' she said. 'And I was carrying soup both times.'
'What is the best thing about winter?' he asked Oliver. Oliver played four notes and said: 'That.'
'How deep is the fjord?' he asked Maya. Maya opened a book, and Diego knew the answer would take a while.
'Why do you climb the lighthouse every morning?' he asked Ingrid. 'Because somebody has to,' she said.
'Where do you sleep?' he asked Kili. Kili said nothing, because condors do not give interviews.
On Thursday Diego had forty answers and still no story. He sat down on the steps and stopped asking.
Then Maya sat next to him. 'You asked everyone a question,' she said. 'Nobody asked YOU one.'
'So: why do you always carry that microphone?' Diego thought for a long time. 'Because I want to remember all of this.'
On Friday the school newspaper had one line on the front page, and everybody read it twice.
